friction: Plan-level operating_points entries (e.g. 'ac|weights|structural_fudge', 'ac|propulsion|engine|rating', 'ac|propulsion|propeller|diameter') were silently ignored: validate_plan passed and the run completed with stock values (engine 750 hp, prop 2.28 m).
config.aircraft_data merged on top of aircraft_template was silently ignored (identical OEW); aircraft_data without a template failed with OpenMDAO connection/set_input_defaults errors.
initial_values with unknown names are silently ignored (no validation error or warning), which made discovering the structural-fudge path trial-and-error.
initial_values were not applied in mode='analysis' runs (OEW unchanged) but were applied in mode='optimize' runs; this behaviour is undocumented.

Structural weight factor has no documented short name; I found it by probing DV names with the 'Output not found for design variable' error. It is per-phase: analysis.<phase>.acmodel.OEW.const.structural_fudge (8 phases), each set to 2.0 via initial_values.

plan_add_dv accepted a bogus DV name without validation, contrary to the reference doc; assemble_plan also reported no errors. validate_plan did not catch unknown DV names; semantic name checks only ran inside run_plan(mode='optimize'), and 'ac|...' pipe names pass preflight even when they don't exist.

get_results(summary=true) output exceeded the tool-response limit and was spilled to a local file I could not read (no filesystem access); I worked around it by requesting explicit variable lists. Wildcard variable patterns are not supported.
The optimizer_iterations validation warning ('1 driver iterations') fires for every optimize run recorded with recording_level='minimal', even though the runs iterated (5–48 s); it is misleading.

Cost-model parameters (fuel price, electricity price, OEM premium, depreciation, battery cost/cycles) cannot be set or inspected via include_cost_model; I assumed the built-in doc_per_nmi matches the paper's model.

Found multiple local optima: fuel-dominant start gave 0.7611452104898269 $/nmi (run-20260928T201528-fbf39b75); battery start 1 gave 0.602185245960558 (run-20260928T201628-d89687f4); battery start 2 gave 0.5607572207352495 (reported run); a warm start from the reported run (run-20260928T201708-da597ce6) reproduced it exactly.
